suitPayment: Pay a 70% advance before production. For a suit order, the balance is due when tailoring is complete, before final cleaning and delivery. Full payment is required before garment release.
standalonePayment: For standalone alterations and cleaning, confirm the required payment and balance conditions in your individual quotation before proceeding. Do not automatically apply custom-suit payment percentages to every service.
balance: With a 70% advance, the balance is 30%. Your actual balance is the agreed total less payments already received.
contents: The documented men’s two-piece suit contains a jacket and trousers; a three-piece adds a waistcoat. Women’s two- and three-piece business or ceremony styles are confirmed in the quotation. Men’s tuxedos have separate packages; ordinary suit accessories and women’s tuxedos must not be assumed.
package: The documented standard Kigali custom-suit package includes initial standard cleaning, protective packaging and initial Kigali delivery. Included services are not charged twice.
extras: Extra fabric, decorations, embroidery, attachments and special requirements need a quotation and confirmation before payment.
higherCollections: Confirm the fabric label, suitability, availability and quotation with the team. Collection or tier names do not establish verified fabric composition. No unverified price schedule is published.
delivery: Initial Kigali delivery is included in the documented standard custom-suit package. Additional or outside-Kigali delivery requires an agreed quotation where applicable. Confirm address, time and required payment before dispatch. No shipping price or delivery deadline is assumed.
timing: Completion, fitting, sourcing and handover arrangements are individually confirmed. Standard 24-hour and Express 2-hour targets concern order confirmation after the required steps, not garment completion.
alterationTiming: Alterations depend on garment condition, requested work, scheduling and fitting arrangements. Confirm the actual quotation and completion arrangements individually.
careTiming: Confirm the cleaning service, suitability and estimated completion date with the team before proceeding. The full schedule depends on the garment, treatment and current capacity.
priceScheduleStatus: UNVERIFIED — latest dated schedule and publication clearance require source verification
